teaching_goal: Explain when proofreading and mismatch repair each happen

scenes.title: During copying: proofreading
scenes.narration: Use timing to distinguish these repair processes. During copying, DNA polymerase can catch a wrong base it just added. Its exonuclease activity removes that incorrect base from the three prime end.

scenes.title: After copying: mismatch repair
scenes.narration: After replication is complete, mismatch repair proteins scan the new double helix. When they find a mismatch, enzymes remove the affected section and replace it with the correct DNA nucleotides.

scenes.title: Two different times
scenes.narration: Proofreading is a check during copying by DNA polymerase itself. Mismatch repair is a check after replication. Both correct mistakes, but the timing and the proteins doing the checking distinguish the two processes.
